In the year 853 A.F.L, not even 10 years before the [[Holy Wars of Therastur]], the kingdom of [[Astoria]] was created: a federation uniting the cities of [[Kadesh]], [[Takht-e Golha]] and [[Cannalis]]. The nearby kingdoms of [[Carvagne]] and [[Asteenor]] joined by the end of the decade, putting an end to a history written in blood. The last century, however, has shifted the focus: from pillage and war to a dangerous political game.

The federation survives on the thin edge of a blade, threatening to collapse the moment a noble considers themselves spurned... And in the year the Carvagnan crown will be named imperator, [[Queen Murielle Ombrejonois]] has died — presumably of natural causes — leaving the kingdom in shambles. The young princess [[Paulette Ombrejonois]] is yet to be wed, and after several weeks of turmoil, [[Baroness Marianne Laflèche]] has announced the engagement of her only son, [[Julien Laflèche]], to the soon-to-be-crowned queen.

In celebration, the entourage of [[House Laflèche]] has moved forward their yearly hunting trip to their ancestral home of [[Ste. Christine-aux-forêts]], where they've been indulging in the pleasures of the local vineyards, the luscious — if scarce this time of the year — game meats and a general ambiance of joy. Whether due to caution or nerves, [[Julien Laflèche]] hasn't been seen much, except when the occasion required it.

After weeks of lavish celebrations, exquisite banquets and abundant parties, life has relaxed in Ste. Christine-aux-forêts. However what's true for the local populace does not apply to a small group of confidents of Baroness Marianne Laflèche. Mathilde, captain of the small guard of the house, and Maestre Guillaume Âge, know that not all is well in the small town. For the only child of House Laflèche, Julien has gone missing. After leaving atop a horse in the early morning, he never returned, only for his horse to appear at the doors of the manor, carrying hunting apparel but no sign of his rider. The Baroness has entrusted them to find him without arising suspicions, and they have in turn obtained the help of local clergyman frère Arnulf, and an agent of the bibliotheca named Victor Età. With a clear objective in mind they've focused their efforts on the only lead they had, brothels, taverns and inns.

In the early morning, the first day of the search for the King-to-be, the Maestre met his associate Victor at La Vielle Teinture, a local apothecary regented by the halfling Clovis, a long standing friend of the Bibliotheca of Ages. After a preliminar meeting, they joined the captain and the clergyman at the Drunkard's Refuge, a seedy tavern that is most commonly free of indiscreet observers and loose-tongued gossips, where they decided on a course of action.

Their first stop was the local brothel, most days a rather luxurious tavern with live-in staff, sometimes a house of pleasure of some repute. The owner, Antoinette welcomed the group, leading them to the young lads that had accompanied the heir a few days before, a blonde handsome man in his mid twenties going by the moniker of "Angel", and a younger brunette woman, half drenched in some sort of rouge body makeup calling herself "Succubus". After a small conversation, and a rather tense interrogation of a well-sculpted worker called Bernard by Victor, the group decided to try their luck elsewhere.

Arnulf and Mathilde make a quick stop at a nearing house, where they met Lucie, a local gossip quite taken with Bernard, getting some muffins for their conversation
